title: Torta magica 2 ingredienti
creator: giuseppe_healthy
steps: Melt the chocolate over a water bath and set aside.
Separate the eggs and whisk the whites to very stiff peaks.
Mix the chocolate with the yolks, then fold in the whites: the first part quickly, the rest slowly, folding from the bottom up.
Pour into a 15 cm tin and bake in a preheated static oven at 180 °C for about 30 minutes. Turn the oven off and leave the cake inside for 5 more minutes.
